files.evidence: Map Snapshot color/depth rows using allocatedHeight-1-y, match ordinary packed UVs to the existing reversed upload and native sampler, present with native rotation (Y,-X), expose active invertY, and snapshot only actually sampled framebuffer units including masks/replacements. Existing MM/LUS contracts and attribution remain unchanged; public coordinate contracts are consulted without implementation import.
Only change the lower-screen diagnostic version from Blinky09 to Blinky10.
Only change the startup marker from startup fix09 to orientation fix10.

Extend the existing independent host collaborators with captured render target, viewport and output flip flags, and an optional bounded raster callback. Preserve resource ownership/fence checks. This remains a collaborator, not a complete hardware emulator.

Invoke asymmetric orientation and unused-framebuffer regressions. Correct the older packed-V and LCD assertions according to the independently checked public coordinate contract; retain all existing combiner, lifetime, blending and depth tests.

New independently written bounded opaque-triangle/nearest-texture test with four unequal color regions, 13x9 logical and16x16 allocated dimensions, raw color/depth sentinels, CPU/GPU comparison, target inversion, cross-convention copies and LCD mapping. Its address/rotation expectations come from the public hardware contract; no external implementation body imported.

New independently written regression drives the production renderer through a nonzero grayscale fallback with absent, stale unused and algebraically canceled framebuffer samplers. Pixel identity is checked alongside actual snapshot counts; real LUS decoding keeps its existing attribution.

hardware_feedback_09.result: Gameplay visible, but the world and HUD positions are vertically reversed; glyphs remain upright.
hardware_feedback_09.limit: Values are read from one user photo, not a benchmark average or an orientation-10 result.

public_contract_references.finding: Landscape Y-up clip coordinates use the native rotation (Y,-X).
Positive viewport half-height and direct viewport/scissor offsets.
Framebuffer texture dimensions are its allocated dimensions, including padding.
Ordinary input rows remain in order; subtexture top V=1 and bottom V=1-h/H corroborate native sampler direction.
Software LCD pixel (x,y from top) occupies linear pixel 240*x+239-y.
Independent PICA model: color and depth raster row y addresses native tiled row H-1-y.
Independent PICA model: sampler V addresses native row H-1-wrap(V*H); viewport uses positive Y.

contract_scope: Public memory/API conventions only; no SDK or emulator implementation body is copied into Blinky.

orientation_contract.storage: Logical raster row y maps to Morton row nativeHeight-1-y for both color and depth.
orientation_contract.packed_uv: Ordinary and framebuffer textures use V=logicalV*logicalHeight/nativeHeight; existing normal upload remains inverted in raw storage.
orientation_contract.presentation: Landscape Y-up coordinates rotate to native clip (Y,-X).
orientation_contract.lus: GetClipParameters reports the active target invertY; existing interpreter projection and viewport semantics remain attributed upstream.
orientation_contract.copy: Preserve the source rectangle and source/destination invertY conversions; Snapshot handles physical storage only.
orientation_contract.readback: Return increasing logical raster rows through Snapshot, matching the existing glReadPixels contract.
orientation_contract.depth: Apply target invertY with logicalHeight, then Snapshot storage conversion with nativeHeight.
orientation_contract.padding: For 400x240 in 512x256, logical raster rows 0 and 239 map to raw rows 255 and 16.
